title: Legacy of Seergaze
start: Talk to the mercenary adventurer east of Paterdomus in Morytania.

ironman.t: Partial completion of Shades of Mort'ton (to make teak pyre logs)

items.t: Combat gear (Necromancy or two different combat styles recommended for lower-level players)
1 coal (can be obtained during the quest)
Lvl-2 enchant tablet (if not on the standard spellbook) or;
1 cosmic rune and 3 air runes (can be obtained during the quest)
1 mithril bar (can be obtained during the quest, metal bank works)
1 silver bar (can be obtained during the quest, metal bank works)
1 silver sickle (b) (can be obtained during the quest)
1 emerald (can be obtained during the quest)

recommended.t: Teleport to Canifis (Kharyrll Teleport or teleport tablets/runes for Canifis portal in a player-owned house) or an activated Canifis lodestone
Invitation box for fast transportation to Paterdomus
Shortcut key (can be stored on a steel key ring, if not planning on using the mines method to return to the Myreque Hideout in Meiyerditch)
Druid pouches or ouroboros pouch (if carrying food through the swamp)
Food (monkfish or higher recommended if you are a low level)
Rod of Ivandis (in case you need to defeat juvinate during the Burgh de Rott Ramble)

rewards.t: Tome of xp 2nd ed, giving 2,500 experience each in any skill that's at least level 35, up to 3 times in total, or 1,250 experience when used on an elite skill.
Ability to craft blood runes at the blood altar with 77 Runecrafting.
Access to Meiyerditch tunnels including skeletal hands, zombie hands, bloodvelds and mutated bloodvelds, as well as a jutting wall shortcut (requires 65 Agility) between Canifis and Meiyerditch.
Access to a furnace in Meiyerditch.
Access to the columbarium beneath Paterdomus and the ability to cremate the vyre corpse for rewards.
Access to vyrewatch event in Temple Trekking.

steps.t: Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer at the Temple Trekking ending point (west of Canifis). CKS or the Canifis lodestone are good options to reach the area quickly. [Chat: Accept › 3 Okay, thanks.]
Enter the Mausoleum west of the Adventurer.
Talk to Drezel. [Chat: 2 Who do you think these suspicious people are? › 4 Okay, thanks.]
Go through the gate west of Drezel and climb down the stairs north of the well.
Search the sparkling wall storage unit a few steps east of the stairs, then go back up the stairs.
Exit the Mausoleum via the west entrance ladder, enter the Paterdomus temple and head to the top floor.
After the cutscene, kill Fistandantilus and Zaromark Sliver (or wait until they time out and teleport away).

sub.t: Both enemies have 2,750 life points, a combat level of 77, and a max hit of 220 in magic and ranged. These enemies will use prayer to become immune to your combat style, but do not protect against necromancy. Necromancy or multiple combat styles are recommended for this fight.

p: The discovery of a blood talisman
The mysterious meeting in the temple

steps.t: Search the crude table in the north-west corner of the room.
Return to Drezel. [Chat: 2 Do you think this has anything to do with the Guthixian Edicts?]
Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer and escort him the same way as any Burgh de Rott Ramble. [Chat: 2 You still want to go to Burgh de Rott? › 1 I can take you to Burgh de Rott.]

sub.t: Easy path recommended for least time and effort. Be sure to remove any melee-reducing equipment like ranged and magic armour. If you encounter juvinates, you will require your Rod of Ivandis or another silver weapon.

steps.t: Once in Burgh de Rott, if the dialogue does not automatically start, talk to the Mercenary Adventurer.

sub.t: If no one with that name is present in Burgh de Rott, skip to the next step.

steps.t: Climb over the wall inside the Pub and then climb down the trapdoor to the cellar.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz until he gives you a crate. [Chat: 2 Do you have a job for me? › 3 Okay, thanks.]
Climb up the ladder.
Go south of Burgh de Rott and take the boat to Meiyerditch.
Go to the Meiyerditch Myreque base. Refer to the Meiyerditch shortcut guide for help. Being caught by the vyrewatch and sent to mines provides a fast and reliable route.
Talk to Flaygian Screwte, in the north room, and offer him your help. [Chat: 3 How's the research going? › 4 Can I help in some way? › 5 Okay, thanks.]
Ask Andiess Juip or Kael Forshaw in the same room about weapons. [Chat: 2 Hi there, I was wondering if I could ask some questions?]
Go to the next room south (near Mekritus A'hara) and search the middle bunk bed on the eastern half of the north wall for a book.
Read it and remember which page mentioned flails.
Give the book to Flaygian, giving him the proper page number. He will give you 10 nails and a hammer. (You can drop the hammer)
Head to the northernmost part of Meiyerditch and enter the house south of the house with the furnace ("mass of debris").
Use the Make-ladder option on the centre post.
Climb up the post.
Jump across the floorboards to the east, then to the north.
Jump west through the damaged wall.
Climb up the ladder and search the trough.
Take a piece of coal from the coal barrel.
Go to the bottom floor and select "dig" on the mass of debris (right click).

sub.t: If the "dig" option doesn't appear, you must go back to the top floor and search the trough

steps.t: Use the coal on the furnace, then light the furnace.
Return and talk to Flaygian, then in the same room;

sub.t: Take 2 silver and 2 mithril bars from the barrel on the northern wall.
Take a blessed sickle from the shelf on the south-western wall.

steps.t: Go to the room to the east of the entrance ladder.
Search the crate for a chain link mould and add it to your tool belt.
Return to the furnace and make the Silvthril chain. It can be found by clicking on the silver bar in the smithing interface (scroll with down arrow next to "Casting Metals & Glass").

sub.t: You do not need to make 2, you will have 1 bar of each type left. These are not used at any point in the quest so you can safely deposit them into your metal bank.

steps.t: Talk to Flaygian, then use the blessed sickle on him. [Chat: 2 How about using this as the head for the flail?]
Talk to Safalaan.
Proceed to the laboratory; the building south-east of the furnace, third from the top on the east wall and through the slashed tapestry.
Dismiss any followers and climb down the stairs.
After the cutscene, Look at one of the bodies in the north-west corner. [Chat: 2 Is there anything I can do? › 3 Okay, thanks.]
Search the door to the south and use the saw in your tool belt.
Climb-through the door, then after the cutscene continue down the long and winding tunnel.
Continue north on the path to the large chamber where the strange stones are.
If you need runes for the Lvl-2 Enchant spell, search the corpse next to the rocks before continuing.

sub.t: Searching the corpse will complete the Bloodstained Treasure achievement, if not already completed.

steps.t: Search the strange stones in the northern part of the cavern.
p: Safalaan and the Myreque fighters lay dead...

steps.t: Talk to Safalaan. There will be a cutscene and a fight against vyrewatches in which you cannot deal any damage, but the fight will end in another cutscene with Safalaan being attacked.
Make sure you have 4 free backpack spaces, then talk to Safalaan.
Use the emerald on the sickle (right click, don't accidentally make bolt tips).
Use the Lvl-2 Enchant spell on it.
Use the chain on it.
Talk to Safalaan.
Go to the surface, equip the Ivandis flail, kill a vyrewatch, and pick up its corpse.
Return to Safalaan.

Return to the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott and talk to Veliaf. Ask him what to do. [Chat: 1 The Flail of Ivandis kills Vyrewatch! › 4 What should I do now? › 5 Okay, thanks.] Ensure your quest log updates to say to speak to Drezel.
Return to and talk to Drezel at the Mausoleum. [Chat: 2 Veliaf asked me to bring this Vyrewatch corpse to you. › 4 Okay, thanks.]
Go through the west gate, then down the stairs north of the well.
Use the pyre logs on a funeral pyre, then the vyre corpse. Light it.
p: Using the Flail of Ivandis to kill a Vyrewatch in Meiyerditch

steps.t: Take the ornate tomb key from the pedestal.
Use it on the wall storage unit from the beginning of the quest on the north-eastern side of the room (the same one that is still sparkling) to acquire a blood talisman.

After the cutscene, go upstairs and ask Drezel what to do. If you still have the library key: [Chat: 2 What should I do now? › 3 Okay, thanks.]. Otherwise, to bypass getting a new key. [Chat: 1 Talk about items. › 2 What should I do now? › 3 Okay, thanks.]
Report to Veliaf in the Burgh de Rott pub basement.
Quest complete!

get_inside.text: The temple's graveyard, and mausoleum entrance
pic: The temple's graveyard, and mausoleum entrance

get_inside.text: Dungeoneering cape teleport to the Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon. Run south and then west. Climb the broken statue to Paterdomus.
Ring of slaying (or ring of slaying (c)) teleport to the Slayer Tower. Run south and then west. Climb the broken statue.
Fairy ring CKS to just west of Canifis. Run west and climb the broken statue.
Invitation box to the Empyrean Citadel, then clicking it again to teleport to Silvarea. Run east. Requires partial completion of the quest Missing, Presumed Death.
Skeletal horror Teleport also takes user just west of the Paterdomus.
Fort Forinthry lodestone. Run south and then east.
Earth altar teleport to earth altar then run north-east.
